title: EXPLAIN and Query Tuning

sections.content: Slow queries usually scan too much: missing indexes, SELECT * pulling unneeded columns, N+1 patterns in app loops, or functions on indexed columns defeating index use.
EXPLAIN (or EXPLAIN ANALYZE) shows the query plan — look for Seq Scan on big tables, bad row estimates, and sort spills. Fix the plan, not the symptom.
Key points: avoid functions on indexed columns (WHERE YEAR(date_col)=2024 kills the index — use ranges), paginate with LIMIT, and measure before/after.

sections.codeExample:
EXPLAIN ANALYZE
SELECT id, name FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01'
ORDER BY created_at
LIMIT 20;
